# Fluri Themes

An independent collection of open-source website effects founded by František Gejdoš.

- Brand and founder: https://fluri.xyz/#founder
- Winter: https://winter.fluri.xyz/ — interactive snowfall, DOM-aware snow accumulation and optional Christmas effects. npm: @fluritheme/fluri and @fluritheme/fluri-react.
- Spider: https://spider.fluri.xyz/ — an animated jumping spider that physically weaves persistent silk and explores the page. npm: @fluritheme/spider.
- Source: https://github.com/fluritheme
- Privacy: https://fluri.xyz/privacy/

The runtime libraries do not report visitors or installations. Each product's documentation, playground and private dashboard live on its own subdomain. Former snow-product paths at fluri.xyz redirect to Winter; legacy APIs remain compatible.
